title: Students protest as air pollution chokes New Delhi

ai.summary: Students protest in New Delhi demanding action on toxic air pollution after the city was ranked the world's most polluted. Police claimed the site was not a permitted venue for such protests.

facts.claim: Students have taken to the streets to demand accountability from authorities over toxic air pollution in New Delhi
facts.quote: Students have taken to the streets to demand accountability from authorities over toxic air pollution in New Delhi

facts.claim: The annual smog has deteriorated further since Diwali, and is expected to worsen during winter
facts.quote: The annual smog has deteriorated further since Diwali, and is expected to worsen during winter

facts.claim: Police said the site was not a permitted venue for such protests
facts.quote: Police said the site was not a permitted venue

ai.background_note: The Delhi clean-air protests began in November 2025 at India Gate, where police claimed the site was not a permitted venue and over 20 arrests were made.
